profile.headline: Software Engineer at Sledgehammer Games
profile.summary:
As an alumna at Franklin and Marshall College, I have explored what is the world of Computer Science and Software Development. 

As a puzzle enthusiast, I am eager to solve the next problem thrown my way. I have a growing passion and curiosity for ways I can make a difference in the world, one program at a time. I am seeking to expand my experience and knowledge in Software and Game Development while having fun along the way.

positions.title: Software Developer - SAP Signavio
positions.description:
- Extended and optimized core API functionalities using Java, Python, and CDS models to serve customer data to the front-end.
- Ensured code quality by implementing integration and unit tests using JUnit and tox.
- Onboarded new engineers and maintained a sense of code ownership within my team as we transitioned from SAP Spotlight to SAP Signavio.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
-Helped reconstruct an Optimized Diet web application that takes a users preferences (allergies, restrictions,etc.) and returns appropriate foods and recipes.
- Used Graphene-Python to build a GraphQL API with Django that returns foods and/or recipes that fit the user's requirements.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Algorithms · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Q&SC Math Tutor
positions.description:
-Tutored 7+ Calculus students on a One-on-One basis.
-Tutored students in math courses ranging from Pre-Calculus (MAT105) up to Linear Algebra and Differential Equations(MAT229).
-Maintained a positive and patient attitude towards tutees, while prioritizing the safety of tutees as a mandatory reporter.

positions.title: Computer Science Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
-Explained Python methods and procedures to students ranging from basic variable naming rules to recursion.
-Explained Algorithms to students to prepare them for higher-level Computer Science courses.
-Maintained a positive, patient, and supportive attitude towards my Lab students in order to see them strive.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Helped program and integrate a venue's ticketing and seat chart system, responsive on mobile and PC.
-Helped create a web app, currently being used in 5+ countries, that unites people with special needs.
-Designed, coded and debugged applications using multiple languages such as .NET, Vue, Angular, JS, TS, JQuery, and more.
-Prepared and installed solutions by determining and designing system specifications, standards, and programming
-Front-end graphical user interface and Back-end implementation in static sites and web applications.

positions.title: Technology Sales Specialist
positions.description:
-Greeted customers and responded to technology questions.
-Provided outstanding customer service. 
-Operated cash registers, managed financial transactions, and balanced drawers. 
-Worked in the Tech hut (Computer repairs, etc)

positions.title: Cyber Security Website Tester (QA)
positions.description: -Analyzed the usability and security of the City of Houston’s Cybersecurity Control Implementation Interface website for the City of Houston Cyber Security Project.

volunteerExperiences.description: Encouraged children to get up and stay active through outdoor activities.

volunteerExperiences.description: Member of a group of students that listened, interviewed and provided campus tours to potential candidates for the professor position at Franklin and Marshall College. I belonged in both Math and Computer Science's Student Interview Committees.

projects.title: Basic Search Engine using Python-NLP libraries
projects.description:
Designed a Search Engine that incorporated Python-NLP libraries. A user could select a query and the most appropriate documents will be returned. The overall goal of this project was to get a hand-on experience and first-person view on how Search Engines began, before the Google era. 
I was able to learn the back-end of basic search engines, the importance of choosing the proper way of weighing your words or terms, and had an insight into how much programs and Search Engines have advanced in a short period.
